# The rule is about the human's turn: no missed frame while the player has the
# move. Scene loads and the AI's own turn on a big board may cost a few; they are read
# out rather than asserted.
wait8 $g_moku_test+30 0 900
write32 $g_moku_test+72 9
wait32 $g_moku_test+72 0 20
frames 6
frames 150
assert16 $g_moku_test+38 0
read32 $g_moku_test+84
